draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.86, the 188th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 27th of 35 at WR. He lasted until pick 249, well after his grade rank (188th): he slid relative to the published grade. Testing concerns: broad jump (10th percentile). College production: 439 receiving yards in 2020, 28th of 35 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the Pittsburgh Steelers. 72 career games and 16 starts over 5 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 1 AV in 2025 against a career-best 4 in 2022. Weak spots: team target share 1.1% (10th percentile), receiving yards 69 (14th percentile). Versus the typical Year-5 wide receiver who played: 69 receiving yards against a median of 255, below the norm.
